title: APICES 2026 - Practice Management Built for Endo Workflows
summary: Join Henry Schein One at APICES 2025 to discover innovative dental software solutions, connect with industry leaders, and discover the future of dentistry.
body_markdown:
Endodontic practices need connected workflows that support referrals, scheduling, documentation, communication, and patient care.


While you’re at APICES, schedule a quick booth demo with Henry Schein One to see how modern practice management tools can help reduce friction, improve visibility, and support the way specialty teams work every day.


## What You'll See In The Demo


- **Smoother referral workflows**
Help keep cases moving from referral to follow-up.
- **Better schedule visibility**
Support your team with a clearer view of the day, cases, and patient flow.
- **Less administrative friction**
See how connected workflows can reduce manual steps across documentation, communication, and daily practice operations.
- **Specialty-focused practice management**
Explore what to look for in software that supports the unique needs of endodontic teams.


**Explore the Future of Specialty Practice Management**


Whether you’re preparing to join a practice, exploring ownership, or evaluating practice management options, this quick demo can help you better understand what modern specialty workflows can look like.
